episodes.title: Capítulo 1: Quinceañera
episodes.summary: On the day of Maya's coronation, an uninvited guest from the Underworld arrives with shocking news about her origins — then delivers a dire ultimatum.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2: La profecía
episodes.summary: A crushing loss sheds new light on an age-old prophecy, sending Maya on a far-flung quest to find three warriors who will help her save the world.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3: El gallo
episodes.summary: On Luna Island, Maya looks for the Rooster Wizard but winds up with the seemingly ordinary Rico, who's said to be "The Greatest Wizard Who Ever Lived."

episodes.title: Capítulo 4: La calavera
episodes.summary: A search for the Jungle Lands' legendary Skull Archer leads Maya and Rico to a gifted warrior: the reclusive Chimi, known to locals as "Monstruo Blanco."

episodes.title: Capítulo 5: El puma
episodes.summary: A burly Golden Mountain Barbarian named Picchu joins Maya's party as the third foretold warrior. Later that night, Zatz confronts Maya about her motives.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6: Maya y los tres
episodes.summary: Lord Mictlan's army attacks Teca, but Maya and her friends fight back. When the gods return, a second battle reveals strengths they didn't know they had.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7: La puerta divina
episodes.summary: Help springs from a surprising source when Maya and the Three come face-to-face with Lord Mictlan. In the end, a noble friend makes a selfless sacrifice.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8: El murciélago y el búho
episodes.summary: After flying from danger, a devastated Maya sends her friends to warn their kingdoms that Lord Mictlan is coming. Lady Micte opens her heart.

episodes.title: Capítulo 9: El sol y la luna
episodes.summary: A fateful battle begins in Teca between Lord Mictlan and his army and Maya and her allies. But how will it all end? In epic fashion.
